onboarding.title: Create your workspace
onboarding.description: A workspace holds your team's Jira connections, AI model and settings.

dashboard.title: Get started
dashboard.connectJiraHint: Read your boards, sprints and issues.
dashboard.connectLlmHint: Your own key powers the assistant.
dashboard.chooseBoardsHint: Pick boards, check the status mapping and run a first sync.

jira.title: Jira connections
jira.description: Connect the Jira sites your teams work in. Credentials are tested before they are saved, then encrypted.
jira.emptyHint: Connect a Jira Cloud site or a Data Center server to start.
jira.addDescription: Use Atlassian sign-in, an API token (Cloud) or a personal access token (Data Center).
jira.name: Connection name
jira.urlHint: Paste any Jira page link — we'll find the base URL.
jira.apiTokenHint: Create one at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens.
jira.patHint: In Jira: Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token.
jira.readOnlyNotice: Only workspace owners and admins can change connections.

boards.description: Choose the boards to sync and how their statuses map to To do, In progress and Done.
boards.emptyHint: Load the boards this connection can see in Jira.
boards.selectionDescription: Selected boards are synced every few minutes and get dashboards.
boards.mappingDescription: Suggested from Jira's status categories. Mark in-progress statuses where work waits (blocked, waiting for review) so flow efficiency counts them as waiting time.

say_do_ratio.title: Say/do ratio
say_do_ratio.description: Completed versus committed at sprint start.

velocity.title: Velocity
velocity.description: Committed at sprint start versus completed at sprint end.

scope_change.title: Scope added
scope_change.description: Work added to the sprint after it started.

carry_over.title: Carried over
carry_over.description: Issues still open when the last sprint closed.

sprint_burndown.title: Sprint burndown
sprint_burndown.description: Work remaining each day against the ideal line.

sprint_burnup.title: Sprint burnup
sprint_burnup.description: Work completed each day against the sprint scope.

cycle_time.title: Cycle time
cycle_time.description: Days from start to done (85th percentile).

throughput_rate.title: Throughput
throughput_rate.description: Issues finished per week, recent average.

wip_trend.title: Work in progress over time
wip_trend.description: Issues in progress at the end of each day.

aging_wip.title: Aging work in progress
aging_wip.description: How long each in-progress issue has been going.

cfd.title: Cumulative flow
cfd.description: Issues per workflow stage, day by day.

flow_efficiency.title: Flow efficiency
flow_efficiency.description: Share of cycle time not spent blocked or waiting.

forecast_how_many.title: How many in the next {days} days?
forecast_how_many.description: Monte Carlo forecast from recent throughput.

forecast_when.title: When will the next {items} be done?
forecast_when.description: Monte Carlo forecast from recent throughput.

hygiene.title: Needs attention
hygiene.description: Stale, unestimated, unassigned or oversized open issues.

agent.title: Assistant
agent.emptyHint: For example: “What is our velocity?” or “Comment on DEMO-1: blocked by the API team”.
agent.placeholder: Ask a question or request a Jira change…
agent.noModelHint: The assistant uses your workspace’s default AI model (your own key).
agent.approvalHint: Nothing is sent to Jira until you approve.
agent.markupHint: Formatting is converted to Jira markup when sent.
agent.superseded: Closed: you moved on without approving.
